              lead=mel, leadvol=60,
              harm=(shift(mel, -3) if n <= 8 else shift(mel, 7)), harmvol=36,
              toms=(n == 16))
    return build_bar(cfg)


def arrangement():
    pats = [('IntroA', intro_a()), ('IntroB', intro_b())]
    for i in range(1, 17):
        pats.append(('M%02d' % i, main_bar(i)))
    for i in range(1, 17):
        pats.append(('B%02d' % i, bridge_bar(i)))
    for i in range(1, 17):
        pats.append(('C%02d' % i, chorus_bar(i)))
    for i in range(1, 9):
        pats.append(('K%02d' % i, break_bar(i)))
    for i in range(1, 17):
        pats.append(('F%02d' % i, final_bar(i)))
    return pats


# ================================================================== assembly
def assemble(path='/workspace/build/tune.xm', verbose=True):
    from ft2api import call
    call('module_new', {'channels': NCH, 'name': 'NEON ASCENT'})
    call('song_set', {'bpm': BPM, 'speed': SPEED, 'loop_start': 0})
    for num, (nm, fn, pan) in INSTR.items():
        call('instrument_set', {'instrument': num, 'name': nm})
        call('sample_load', {'path': os.path.join(SAMPLE_DIR, fn), 'instrument': num, 'sample': 0})
        a = {'instrument': num, 'sample': 0, 'name': nm, 'volume': 64, 'panning': pan}
        if fn in LOOPS:
            na, nl = LOOPS[fn]
            a.update({'flags': 2, 'loop_start': int(na), 'loop_length': int(nl)})
        call('sample_set', a)
    pats = arrangement()
    for pi, (nm, cells) in enumerate(pats):
        call('pattern_set_length', {'pattern': pi, 'rows': ROWS})
        call('pattern_clear', {'pattern': pi})
    n = 0
    for pi, (nm, cells) in enumerate(pats):
        for c, evs in cells.items():
            for (r, a) in evs:
                assert 0 <= r < ROWS, (nm, c, r)
                call('pattern_set_cell', dict(a, pattern=pi, row=r, channel=c))
                n += 1
    for pi in range(len(pats)):
        call('order_set', {'position': pi, 'pattern': pi})
    call('song_set', {'bpm': BPM, 'speed': SPEED, 'length': len(pats), 'loop_start': 2})
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    call('module_save', {'path': path, 'format': 'xm'})
    if verbose:
        print('module:', call('module_info', {}), '| cells', n, '| patterns', len(pats))
    return pats


if __name__ == '__main__':
    assemble()

              harm=(shift(mel, -3) if n <= 8 else shift(mel, 3)), harmvol=34)
    if n in (2, 10):
        cfg['leadfx'] = ((0,), (EFF['vibrato'], (4 << 4) | 24))
    return build_bar(cfg)


def break_bar(n):
    chd = PROG['K'][(n - 1) % 8]
    mel = KB1.get(((n - 1) % 4) + 1)
    cfg = CFG(chd,
              kick=('off' if n <= 2 else ('float' if n <= 4 else ('fill' if n == 8 else 'half'))),
              snare=('off' if n <= 3 else ('roll' if n == 8 else 'back')),
              hat=('off' if n <= 1 else ('e8' if n <= 4 else '16s')), hatdyn=(20 if n <= 4 else 36),
              bass=('off' if n <= 3 else 'norm'), str=(28 if n <= 4 else 0), pad=(0 if n <= 4 else 32),
              arp=(1 if n >= 3 else 0), arpdyn=(24, 16),
              arp16=((0, 0, 12, 14, 0, 0, 12, 14) if n >= 6 else 0),
              bell=(20 if n >= 2 else 0), bellph=n + 3,
              shaker=(12 if n >= 6 else 0), crash=(42 if n == 1 else 0),
              toms=(n in (3, 4, 8)), riser=(38 if n in (2, 4, 6, 8) else 0),
              lead=mel, leadvol=(42 if n <= 4 else 52),
              harm=(shift(mel, -5) if n >= 5 else None), harmvol=28)
    return build_bar(cfg)


def final_bar(n):
    chd = PROG['I'][(n - 1) % 8]
    if n <= 12:
        mel = HOOK.get(((n - 1) % 4) + 1)
    else:
        mel = OUT_MEL.get(((n - 1) % 4) + 1)
    cfg = CFG(chd,
              kick=('fill' if n in (8, 16) else 'hard'),
              snare=('roll' if n in (8, 15, 16) else 'ghost'),
              hat=('16' if n >= 13 else 'e8o'), hatdyn=48,
              bass='walk', pad=40, arp=1, arpdyn=(40, 30),
              arp16=((0, 0, 18, 20, 0, 0, 18, 20) if n % 2 == 0 else (14, 0, 0, 16, 14, 0, 0, 16)),
              bell=26, bellph=n, shaker=20, crash=(50 if n in (1, 9, 13, 16) else 0),
              riser=(34 if n in (8, 16) else 0),
              stab=((12, 36) if n in (4, 12) else ((24,) if n in (8, 16) else ())), stabvol=44,
              perc=('e8' if n >= 5 else 'off'),
              lead=mel, leadvol=60,
              harm=(shift(mel, -3) if n <= 8 else shift(mel, 7)), harmvol=36,
              toms=(n == 16))
    return build_bar(cfg)


def arrangement():
    pats = [('IntroA', intro_a()), ('IntroB', intro_b())]
    for i in range(1, 17):
        pats.append(('M%02d' % i, main_bar(i)))
    for i in range(1, 17):
        pats.append(('B%02d' % i, bridge_bar(i)))
    for i in range(1, 17):
        pats.append(('C%02d' % i, chorus_bar(i)))
    for i in range(1, 9):
        pats.append(('K%02d' % i, break_bar(i)))
    for i in range(1, 17):
        pats.append(('F%02d' % i, final_bar(i)))
    return pats


# ================================================================== assembly
def assemble(path='/workspace/build/tune.xm', verbose=True):
    from ft2api import call
    call('module_new', {'channels': NCH, 'name': 'NEON ASCENT'})
    call('song_set', {'bpm': BPM, 'speed': SPEED, 'loop_start': 0})
    for num, (nm, fn, pan) in INSTR.items():
        call('instrument_set', {'instrument': num, 'name': nm})
        call('sample_load', {'path': os.path.join(SAMPLE_DIR, fn), 'instrument': num, 'sample': 0})
        a = {'instrument': num, 'sample': 0, 'name': nm, 'volume': 64, 'panning': pan}
        if fn in LOOPS:
            na, nl = LOOPS[fn]
            a.update({'flags': 2, 'loop_start': int(na), 'loop_length': int(nl)})
        call('sample_set', a)
    pats = arrangement()
    for pi, (nm, cells) in enumerate(pats):
        call('pattern_set_length', {'pattern': pi, 'rows': ROWS})
        call('pattern_clear', {'pattern': pi})
    n = 0
    for pi, (nm, cells) in enumerate(pats):
        for c, evs in cells.items():
            for (r, a) in evs:
                assert 0 <= r < ROWS, (nm, c, r)
                call('pattern_set_cell', dict(a, pattern=pi, row=r, channel=c))
                n += 1
    for pi in range(len(pats)):
        call('order_set', {'position': pi, 'pattern': pi})
    call('song_set', {'bpm': BPM, 'speed': SPEED, 'length': len(pats), 'loop_start': 2})
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    call('module_save', {'path': path, 'format': 'xm'})
    if verbose:
        print('module:', call('module_info', {}), '| cells', n, '| patterns', len(pats))
    return pats


if __name__ == '__main__':
    assemble()

def voice(tag, ref_written, dur, amps, det=(0.0,), sub=0.0, atk=0.0012, tau=0.12,

import numpy as np, wave
w=wave.open('/workspace/build/tune.wav'); n=w.getnframes()
